mapper.select: SELECT k.id, k.name, k.key_group AS keyGroup, k.api_key AS apiKey, k.is_enabled AS isEnabled, k.expired_at AS expiredAt, k.max_amount AS maxAmount, k.max_requests AS maxRequests, k.max_concurrent_requests AS maxConcurrentRequests, k.request_limit_reset_at AS requestLimitResetAt, k.supported_models AS supportedModels, COALESCE(COUNT(r.id), 0) AS totalRequests, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN UPPER(r.status) != 'SUCCESS' THEN 0 WHEN k.request_limit_reset_at IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN r.request_time IS NOT NULL AND r.request_time > k.request_limit_reset_at THEN 1 WHEN r.request_time IS NULL AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(r.created_at) > k.request_limit_reset_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS requestLimitUsed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(r.status) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successRequests, COALESCE(SUM(r.input_tokens), 0) AS totalInputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.output_tokens), 0) AS totalOutputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM api_keys k LEFT JOIN request_logs r ON k.api_key = r.api_key GROUP BY k.id, k.name, k.key_group, k.api_key, k.is_enabled, k.expired_at, k.max_amount, k.max_requests, k.max_concurrent_requests, k.request_limit_reset_at, k.supported_models ORDER BY k.id

SELECT k.id, k.name, k.key_group AS keyGroup, k.api_key AS apiKey, k.is_enabled AS isEnabled, k.expired_at AS expiredAt, k.max_amount AS maxAmount, k.max_requests AS maxRequests, k.max_concurrent_requests AS maxConcurrentRequests, k.request_limit_reset_at AS requestLimitResetAt, k.supported_models AS supportedModels, COALESCE(COUNT(r.id), 0) AS totalRequests, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN UPPER(r.status) != 'SUCCESS' THEN 0 WHEN k.request_limit_reset_at IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN r.request_time IS NOT NULL AND r.request_time > k.request_limit_reset_at THEN 1 WHEN r.request_time IS NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s', r.created_at) AS INTEGER) > k.request_limit_reset_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS requestLimitUsed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(r.status) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successRequests, COALESCE(SUM(r.input_tokens), 0) AS totalInputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.output_tokens), 0) AS totalOutputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM api_keys k LEFT JOIN request_logs r ON k.api_key = r.api_key GROUP BY k.id, k.name, k.key_group, k.api_key, k.is_enabled, k.expired_at, k.max_amount, k.max_requests, k.max_concurrent_requests, k.request_limit_reset_at, k.supported_models ORDER BY k.id

SELECT k.id, k.name, k.key_group AS keyGroup, k.api_key AS apiKey, k.is_enabled AS isEnabled, k.expired_at AS expiredAt, k.max_amount AS maxAmount, k.max_requests AS maxRequests, k.max_concurrent_requests AS maxConcurrentRequests, k.request_limit_reset_at AS requestLimitResetAt, k.supported_models AS supportedModels, COALESCE(COUNT(r.id), 0) AS totalRequests, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.id IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN UPPER(r.status) != 'SUCCESS' THEN 0 WHEN k.request_limit_reset_at IS NULL THEN 1 WHEN r.request_time IS NOT NULL AND r.request_time > k.request_limit_reset_at THEN 1 WHEN r.request_time IS NULL AND UNIX_TIMESTAMP(r.created_at) > k.request_limit_reset_at THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS requestLimitUsed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(r.status) = 'SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successRequests, COALESCE(SUM(r.input_tokens), 0) AS totalInputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.output_tokens), 0) AS totalOutputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM api_keys k LEFT JOIN request_logs r ON k.api_key = r.api_key WHERE (#{isEnabled} IS NULL OR k.is_enabled = #{isEnabled}) AND (#{keyGroup} IS NULL OR k.key_group = #{keyGroup}) AND (#{keyword} IS NULL OR k.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR k.api_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) GROUP BY k.id, k.name, k.key_group, k.api_key, k.is_enabled, k.expired_at, k.max_amount, k.max_requests, k.max_concurrent_requests, k.request_limit_reset_at, k.supported_models ORDER BY k.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
